appName.description: Short product name for headings inside the extension. Not translated.

extDescription.message: Brings back the Dim dark blue theme X removed, plus the Twitter bird logo, classic font, and old image grid.

pausedLight.description: Popup note under the toggle when Dim is on but X itself is showing its light theme (Dim only recolours X's dark theme). Followed by the switchToDim button.

switchToDim.description: Popup: text button after the pausedLight note. Puts X in dark mode so Dim shows. Use the same word for Dim as dimLabel.

credit.description: Footer follow link in the popup and Extras page

welcomeSubtitleInstall.message: Dim Mode brings back the Dim dark blue theme that X removed — and adds a lot more.

welcomeSubtitleUpdate.message: Thanks for sticking with us. Here's what's new:

installFeature1.message: Restores X's Dim dark blue background

installFeature2.message: Pick from 6 color themes, or choose your own color

installFeature3.message: Extras: the bird logo, the classic font, the old favicon, and “Tweet” instead of “Post”

installFeature4.message: More Extras: start on the Following timeline, and bring back the classic image grid

installFeature5.message: Works across X and X Pro — settings sync across your devices

updateFeature1.message: Dim is back as an option in X’s own display settings

updateFeature2.message: Switching Dim on now turns X Dim right away, even from Light

updateFeature3.message: Colors, Chat and the classic Extras all work on the new X

installFeature6.message: Easier on the eyes — dim backgrounds reduce halation for users with astigmatism

tipBird.message: Brings back the Twitter bird in place of the X logo.
tipBird.description: Extras: explanation shown when hovering the info icon next to "Classic bird logo". One short sentence.

tipFont.message: Uses the font Twitter had for years instead of X's current one.
tipFont.description: Extras: explanation shown when hovering the info icon next to "Classic font". One short sentence.

tipFavicon.message: Shows the blue bird in the browser tab and names the tab Twitter.
tipFavicon.description: Extras: explanation shown when hovering the info icon next to "Classic favicon". One short sentence.

tipWording.message: Says Tweet and Retweet instead of Post and Repost.
tipWording.description: Extras: explanation shown when hovering the info icon next to "Tweet, not Post". One short sentence.

tipButtonColor.message: Colors buttons like Post and Follow: white, your theme color, or any color you pick.
tipButtonColor.description: Extras: explanation shown when hovering the info icon next to "Button color". One short sentence.

tipImageGrid.message: Shows 2 to 4 photos in a post as a grid, not a row you have to swipe.
tipImageGrid.description: Extras: explanation shown when hovering the info icon next to "Classic image grid". One short sentence.

tipFollowing.message: Opens Home on Following instead of For you.
tipFollowing.description: Extras: explanation shown when hovering the info icon next to "Start on Following". One short sentence.

tipCopyLink.message: Moves Copy link to the top of a post's share menu.
tipCopyLink.description: Extras: explanation shown when hovering the info icon next to "Copy link first". One short sentence.

tipHideGrok.message: Removes Grok from the sidebar, posts, profiles and the floating button.
tipHideGrok.description: Extras: explanation shown when hovering the info icon next to "Hide Grok". One short sentence.
